snippet.title: LavaLoop Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
An explosive musical show set in a hand-drawn retro-futuristic universe. From shoot’em up to rhythm game, take on the role of three punk musicians, confronting a mad queen and her planet-killing machine. Discover a surprising gameplay blending arcade, music and comics!
- Join the Playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017100
- Play the demo: https://louisrigaud.itch.io/lavaloop
- Join Discord: https://discord.gg/33KkFcES
- Follow on Kickstarter: kickstarter.com/projects/356896077/lavaloop

Credits
Story, Art, Game Design, Code: Louis Rigaud
Music: Raphael Joffres / Fractal Edge Music
Sound Design: Romain Raynal
